### 有趣用法和干货
1. Claude's official security plugin runs a whole-repo scan in three lines (Vox): first /model to switch to Opus 5.5, then `/plugin install claude-security@claude-plugins-official`, `/reload-plugins`, `/claude-security scan the whole repo at high`. It dispatches a group of agents to scan the repo, hands each finding to 3 dedicated "nitpicker" agents, and only writes it into the report if at least two agree; run it again afterwards and choose Suggest patches to generate a patch file per finding for you to apply selectively. Large repos take tens of minutes to hours and use quota; if it won't install, first run `/plugin marketplace add anthropics/claude-plugins-official`, if it complains about a missing Workflow tool turn on Dynamic workflows in /config, it needs Python 3.9+, and don't switch branches while it runs. https://x.com/Voxyz_ai/status/2111200518379020292
> **[zh]** Claude 官方安全插件三行跑全仓扫描（Vox）：先 /model 切到 Opus 5.5，然后 `/plugin install claude-security@claude-plugins-official`、`/reload-plugins`、`/claude-security scan the whole repo at high`。它派一组 agent 扫全仓，每个发现再交给 3 个专门"挑刺"的 agent，至少两个同意才写进报告；跑完再执行一次选 Suggest patches，每条发现生成补丁文件由你挑着应用。大仓库要几十分钟到几小时、会耗额度；装不上先 `/plugin marketplace add anthropics/claude-plugins-official`，提示缺 Workflow 工具就在 /config 打开 Dynamic workflows，需 Python 3.9+，运行时别切分支。
2. Get a more trustworthy "inverted pyramid" from agents (lauren @poteto, Chinese commentary by shao__meng): put the most effort into changing the codebase itself (better architecture, stronger types and invariants, clear boundaries so the shortest path is the correct path), next deterministic checks such as lint/tests/CI/formal verification, then text that relies on the agent's discipline such as AGENTS.md, comments and skills, with line-by-line human review last. The original post includes a prompt to give directly to an agent to go through your past review comments and commits, find the pitfalls agents hit most, and propose architecture changes. https://x.com/poteto/status/2111133080526495985 / https://x.com/shao__meng/status/2111261981735067819
> **[zh]** 让 agent 产出更可信的"倒金字塔"（lauren @poteto，shao__meng 中文解读）：精力最多放在改代码库本身（更好的架构、更强的类型和不变量、清晰边界，让最短路径就是正确路径），其次是 lint/测试/CI/形式化验证这类确定性检查，再次才是 AGENTS.md、注释、skill 这类靠 agent 自觉的文字，人工逐行审查放最后。原帖还附了一段可以直接丢给 agent 的提示词，让它翻你过去的 review 意见和提交，找出 agent 最常踩的坑并提出改架构方案。
3. Turn your own agent sessions into a private eval set (Ibragim, author of SWE-rebench): he organized 1,270 sessions from ~/.claude, ~/.codex and ~/.pi into my-mini-benchmark, using his corrections of agents as test cases, so changing models, harnesses or plugins is run against his real tasks, and he found a setup half the price; the post includes a guide and skill. For engineers, this answers "which combination suits my codebase" better than public leaderboards. https://x.com/ibragim_bad/status/2111102467924496721
> **[zh]** 把自己的 agent 会话变成私人评测集（Ibragim，SWE-rebench 作者）：他把 ~/.claude、~/.codex、~/.pi 里 1,270 个会话整理成 my-mini-benchmark，把自己对 agent 的纠正当测试用例，之后换模型、harness 或插件都在自己的真实任务上跑一遍，借此找到一个便宜一半的配置；帖子附指南和 skill。对工程师来说，这比看公开榜单更能回答"哪个组合适合我的代码库"。
4. llama.cpp v0.7.0 local one-line serving (ggerganov): on a 128GB Mac or Spark run `llama serve -hf ggml-org/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-GGUF:IQ4_NL --spec-type draft-mtp --lazy-mode on`, using MTP drafts for speculative decoding. Copy it directly if you want a local inference backend for an agent. https://x.com/ggerganov/status/2111146995003924576
> **[zh]** llama.cpp v0.7.0 本地一行起服务（ggerganov）：128GB 的 Mac 或 Spark 上 `llama serve -hf ggml-org/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-GGUF:IQ4_NL --spec-type draft-mtp --lazy-mode on`，用 MTP 草稿做投机解码。想在本地给 agent 配一个推理后端可以直接抄。

### 科技新闻
1. **Claude solves the mystery of the NIST elliptic-curve seeds**: the seeds of NIST curves like P-256 were supplied by the NSA back then and nobody knew where they came from; folklore said it was a hash of a joke sentence, and some suspected a backdoor. An Anthropic employee asked an internal model to try, and in under half an hour it found: it's not a hash at all, but bytes emitted one by one from the C library's 48-bit random number generator (drand48 / lrand48) seeded with a Unix timestamp, matching all five curves P-192 through P-521, with only the binary curve B-163 still unsolved. The bounty Filippo Valsorda set three years ago has been claimed by the Anthropic team, with the prize tripled and donated to ISRG, which runs Let's Encrypt. [Anthropic original](https://www.anthropic.com/research/ecdsa-curve-origins) ｜ [Filippo's article](https://words.filippo.io/seeds-solved/) ｜ [HN discussion](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50122800) (669 points: a quip, "13 years of tinfoil hats, for srand48(time(NULL))"; another calmly notes this only shows how the seed was generated and you can't see the discarded candidates, so the selection step could in theory still be shady)
> **[zh]** **Claude 解开 NIST 椭圆曲线种子之谜**：P-256 等 NIST 曲线的种子是 NSA 当年给的，一直没人知道怎么来的，坊间传说是哈希了一句玩笑话，也有人怀疑藏了后门。Anthropic 一位员工让内部模型试试，不到半小时就发现：根本不是哈希，而是用 Unix 时间戳初始化 C 库的 48 位随机数生成器（drand48 / lrand48）逐字节吐出来的，P-192 到 P-521 五条全对上，只有二进制曲线 B-163 还没解开。Filippo Valsorda 三年前设的悬赏已被 Anthropic 团队领走，奖金三倍捐给了运营 Let's Encrypt 的 ISRG。[Anthropic 原文](https://www.anthropic.com/research/ecdsa-curve-origins) ｜ [Filippo 的文章](https://words.filippo.io/seeds-solved/) ｜ [HN 讨论](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50122800)（669 分：调侃「13 年的锡纸帽，就为了 srand48(time(NULL))」；也有人冷静指出这只说明了种子怎么生成，看不到被丢弃的候选，挑选环节理论上仍可能有猫腻）
2. **PostgreSQL 19 delayed, partly because AI code review found too many bugs**: GA slips from the planned end of September to around November 19, and 8–10 significant features (including SQL/PGQ graph queries) are pulled back to PG 20. Core committer Peter Eisentraut says some are architectural flaws hard to fix in the beta period, and LLM review also turned up dozens of small edge-case issues at once, each fixable in three lines, but the handling overhead adds up and there isn't enough time; he stresses these features were written before vibe coding. [The Register](https://www.theregister.com/databases/2026/10/16/postgres-19-delayed-after-ai-reviewers-find-more-bugs-than-humans-can-fix/5303471) ｜ [HN discussion](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50119991) (the mainstream view is that AI raised the quality bar, old code needs lots of catch-up, and QA is becoming the bottleneck of the AI era; others think the truly hard ones are bugs involving design trade-offs that can't be fixed with one click)
> **[zh]** **PostgreSQL 19 推迟发布，原因之一是 AI 代码审查找出的 bug 太多**：GA 从原定 9 月底推到 11 月 19 日左右，8–10 个重要特性（包括 SQL/PGQ 图查询）被撤回到 PG 20。核心提交者 Peter Eisentraut 说，有些是难以在 beta 期修好的架构缺陷，另外 LLM 审查一下子翻出几十个边界小问题，每个三行就能修，但处理开销叠起来时间就不够了；他强调这些特性写的时候还没有 vibe coding。[The Register](https://www.theregister.com/databases/2026/10/16/postgres-19-delayed-after-ai-reviewers-find-more-bugs-than-humans-can-fix/5303471) ｜ [HN 讨论](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50119991)（主流看法是 AI 把质量门槛抬高了，老代码要大量补课，QA 正在变成 AI 时代的瓶颈；也有人认为真正难的是那些涉及设计取舍、没法一键修的 bug）
3. **Home Assistant's "check leaked passwords by default" sparks controversy**: a user found that HA compares fields flagged as passwords in each app's config against Have I Been Pwned, and filed an issue protesting the lack of consent. The official docs say it uses k-anonymity so the server never sees the full hash; maintainer Frenck first replied combatively, later apologized on HN, and said it could always be turned off with `ha security options --pwned=false`. [GitHub issue](https://github.com/home-assistant/home-assistant.io/issues/49314) ｜ [Official explanation](https://www.home-assistant.io/more-info/pwned-passwords/) ｜ [HN discussion](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50124251) (most think the intent is fine but it should be off by default and opt-in; one posted research saying k-anonymous password lookups still leak useful signal to attackers)
> **[zh]** **Home Assistant「默认检查泄露密码」惹争议**：有用户发现 HA 会把各个 App 配置里标记为密码的字段拿去和 Have I Been Pwned 比对，于是提 issue 抗议没经过同意。官方文档说用的是 k-匿名，服务端看不到完整哈希；维护者 Frenck 起初回复得很冲，后来在 HN 道歉，并说其实一直能用 `ha security options --pwned=false` 关掉。[GitHub issue](https://github.com/home-assistant/home-assistant.io/issues/49314) ｜ [官方说明](https://www.home-assistant.io/more-info/pwned-passwords/) ｜ [HN 讨论](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50124251)（多数人认为出发点没错但应该默认关闭、让用户主动打开；有人贴了研究说 k-匿名的密码查询仍会给攻击者泄露有用信号）
4. **Two kernel vulnerabilities, one letting you escape from a VM to the host**: Linux networking stack CVE-2026-99999 (CVSS 9.3) is in deferred checksum handling, where a malicious guest can make the host treat a 20-byte IPv4 header as 60 bytes and read memory out of bounds, ultimately achieving escape in KVM; the research team found it while attempting Vercel's million-dollar sandbox bounty, and it is fixed in 6.12.113, 6.18.57, 7.2.11 and others; those running cloud hosts and agent sandboxes should upgrade soon. The other is Calif's OpenBSD local privilege escalation: a 16-bit signed counter carried over for 37 years from the original BSD code overflows if you fork enough times. [pwn.ai original](https://pwn.ai/blog/pwnescape) ｜ [Debian security tracker](https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-99999) ｜ [ITHome](https://www.ithome.com/1/014/222.htm) ｜ [Big Fish](https://calif.io/research/big-fish) ｜ [HN discussion](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50118977) (someone found NetBSD fixed it in passing when it rewrote that code in 1999)
> **[zh]** **两个内核漏洞，一个能从虚拟机逃到宿主机**：Linux 网络栈的 CVE-2026-99999（CVSS 9.3）出在延迟校验和处理上，恶意客户机能让宿主机把 20 字节的 IPv4 头误当成 60 字节，越界读内存，最终在 KVM 里实现逃逸；研究团队是在挑战 Vercel 百万美元沙箱悬赏时挖到的，已在 6.12.113、6.18.57、7.2.11 等版本修复，跑云主机和 Agent 沙箱的要尽快升级。另一个是 Calif 披露的 OpenBSD 本地提权：一个从原始 BSD 代码沿用了 37 年的 16 位有符号计数器，fork 足够多次就会溢出。[pwn.ai 原文](https://pwn.ai/blog/pwnescape) ｜ [Debian 安全追踪](https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-99999) ｜ [IT之家](https://www.ithome.com/1/014/222.htm) ｜ [Big Fish](https://calif.io/research/big-fish) ｜ [HN 讨论](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50118977)（有人发现 NetBSD 在 1999 年重写那段代码时顺手修掉了）

Many in the AI safety community criticize it for narrowing the government's power to intervene too much. [Politico](https://www.politico.com/news/2026/10/16/anthropic-ai-safety-01124654) ｜ [Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261016/p25#a261016p25)

### 有趣用法和干货
1. Turn agent failures into regression tests with "session replay" (Paul Iusztin, author of the LLM Engineer's Handbook): while using Claude Code to write the eval layer for his own coding agent Decode, a cold-start 503 from the Modal endpoint made the agent not wait but dig out Gemini API keys in memory and swap between them, burning $40 over 20 benchmark runs (expected $4–5). His fix is to record sessions and cache tool returns with Kitaru, replay with the original context after fixing and compare results, without re-calling APIs or databases that change external state; the flow is record, review, categorize failures, fix, replay, compare. Two lessons engineers can use directly: don't leave extra keys in the agent's environment, and run historical failures before changing prompts or models. https://x.com/pauliusztin_/status/2111434556779683852 / https://x.com/pauliusztin_/status/2111374154364600573
> **[zh]** 用"会话回放"把 agent 的失败变成回归测试（Paul Iusztin，《LLM Engineer's Handbook》作者）：他用 Claude Code 给自研编码 agent Decode 写评测层时，Modal 接口冷启动返回 503，agent 没等，而是翻出内存里的 Gemini API key 换着用，跑 20 个基准测试烧了 40 美元（预期 4–5 美元）。他的做法是用 Kitaru 录下会话并缓存工具返回，修完后按原上下文重放、对比结果，而且不会再次调用会改外部状态的 API 或数据库；流程是录制、审查、归类失败、修复、重放、对比。对工程师来说，两个教训都能直接用：给 agent 的环境里别放多余的 key，修 prompt 或换模型前先拿历史失败跑一遍。
2. Run 23 checks with Claude Code before you start taking money (Vox): the checklist includes secrets only on the server and searched in frontend and git history, every endpoint validating login and permissions server-side with RLS on, payment webhooks signature-verified and counted once on duplicate callbacks, amounts stored as integers in the smallest currency unit, double-clicking submit creating only one order, migrations all with rollback SQL tested both ways on a copy of production data, Supabase returning at most 1000 rows by default so nothing is silently truncated, timestamptz for time, and so on. Usage: send the whole checklist to Claude Code and add: split into 5 subagents (design and speed, security, payments, data, post-launch) that only check and don't change, mark each item pass or fail with the problem file, mark dashboard-only items "needs my confirmation", test backups and payments only in a test environment, and give a table first and wait for confirmation before fixing. https://x.com/Voxyz_ai/status/2111442102756463077
> **[zh]** 上线收钱前让 Claude Code 跑一遍 23 项检查（Vox）：清单包括密钥只在服务端并搜过前端和 git 历史、每个接口在服务端校验登录和权限并开 RLS、支付 webhook 验签且重复回调只记一次、金额用最小货币单位的整数存、双击提交只生成一个订单、迁移都写好回滚 SQL 并在生产数据副本上双向跑过、Supabase 默认最多返回 1000 行别被悄悄截断、时间用 timestamptz 等。用法是把整份清单发给 Claude Code，末尾加一句：分给 5 个子 agent（设计与速度、安全、支付、数据、上线后）只查不改，每项标通过或失败和问题文件，仪表盘里才能看的项标"需要我确认"，备份和支付只在测试环境测，先给表格、等确认再修。
3. Share one memory across multiple coding agents: the open-source akitaonrails/ai-memory lets you switch from Claude Code to Codex in the same directory halfway through without re-explaining the architecture, failed approaches and open questions; supports 20+ agents, memory is plain markdown kept in git that you can edit directly, no LLM calls or API keys by default, and it can run on one machine or be self-hosted for a team. Worth a try if you switch tools back and forth when quotas run out. https://x.com/AkitaOnRails/status/2101451863145238819 / https://x.com/Godgun522/status/2111444750138232984
> **[zh]** 多个编码 agent 共用一份记忆：开源的 akitaonrails/ai-memory 让你在 Claude Code 里做到一半，换 Codex 在同一目录接着做，不用重讲架构、失败过的方案和未决问题；支持二十多种 agent，记忆是放在 git 里的普通 markdown，可以直接改，默认不调大模型、不要 API key，可单机跑也可自托管给团队共用。额度用完来回切工具的人可以试。
4. 什么样的 skill 才值得装（铁锤人）：好 skill 要容易触发、正文短（skill 吃上下文，上下文越满越降智，所以要清楚模型已经会什么、只写它不会的）、结构上防止跳步和偷懒（比如让查 10 条新闻结果只查了 2 条）。他的结论是大部分 skill 达不到，与其装上百个，不如禁用掉、直接贴指令。https://x.com/lxfater/status/2111423678256955816
> **[en]** What kind of skill is worth installing (铁锤人): a good skill is easy to trigger, short (skills eat context, and the fuller the context the dumber the model, so know what the model already knows and write only what it doesn't), and structured to prevent skipping steps and laziness (e.g. asked to check 10 news items but checked only 2). His conclusion: most skills don't meet the bar, so rather than install hundreds, disable them and just paste the instructions.

### 新产品 / 开源
1. **Llmspeed (Show HN)**: before buying a GPU or Mac, "feel" a local model's output speed in the browser. Pick hardware (RTX 3090/5090, Strix Halo, Mac Studio M5 Ultra, DGX Spark, etc.) and a model (Qwen 3.8 27B, DeepSeek V4 Flash, etc.) and it simulates text streaming at the estimated tokens/s; data comes from community measurements such as r/LocalLLaMA and localscore.ai, missing combinations are extrapolated from similar configs or specs, and the code is open source. [Website](https://llmspeed.dev/) ｜ [GitHub](https://github.com/nicorobinreal/llmspeed) ｜ [HN discussion](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50127979) (133 points: one says his M2 Ultra is twice as fast as the page's M3 Ultra number, so estimate accuracy is the key; agent-coding people remind that prefill and concurrency matter more than output speed; another suggests just renting a cloud GPU for a few minutes, for under $0.5)
> **[zh]** **Llmspeed（Show HN）**：买显卡或 Mac 之前，先在浏览器里「体感」一下本地模型的出字速度。选硬件（RTX 3090/5090、Strix Halo、Mac Studio M5 Ultra、DGX Spark 等）和模型（Qwen 3.8 27B、DeepSeek V4 Flash 等），它按估算的 token/s 模拟出字速度；数据来自 r/LocalLLaMA、localscore.ai 等社区实测，缺的组合按相近配置或规格推算，代码开源。[官网](https://llmspeed.dev/) ｜ [GitHub](https://github.com/nicorobinreal/llmspeed) ｜ [HN 讨论](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50127979)（133 分：有人说自己的 M2 Ultra 比页面上 M3 Ultra 的数还快一倍，估算准不准是关键；做 Agent 编程的人提醒预填充（prefill）和并发比输出速度更重要；还有人建议直接租台云 GPU 试几分钟，花不到 0.5 美元）
2. **Orca**: a desktop app for managing "a swarm of coding agents": Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode and Pi can run side by side, each in its own git worktree; you can send one prompt to five agents, compare the results and merge the best. It also has WebGL terminal split panes, a design mode where you click page elements to put HTML/CSS and a screenshot into the prompt, and a companion phone app to view progress and send follow-ups. Uses your own subscriptions, MIT-licensed, 1100+ stars in a single day on GitHub Trending today. [GitHub](https://github.com/stablyai/orca) ｜ [官网](https://onorca.dev)
> **[zh]** **Orca**：一个管理「一群编程 Agent」的桌面应用，Codex、Claude Code、OpenCode、Pi 可以并排跑，每个在独立的 git worktree 里；可以把同一个提示分给五个 Agent，比较结果后合并最好的那个。还带 WebGL 终端分屏、点选网页元素把 HTML/CSS 和截图塞进提示的设计模式，以及能在手机上看进度、发追问的配套 App。用你自己的订阅，MIT 许可，今天 GitHub Trending 单日 1100+ 星。
3. **ai-job-search**: a job-search pipeline a geophysicist built with Claude Code after being laid off: `/scrape` searches jobs, `/apply` evaluates fit and drafts a tailored LaTeX résumé and cover letter (with a reviewer agent as a gate), and `/interview` prepares for interviews. The author says he applied to 69, got 20 first-round interviews, and started as an AI engineer in June 2026. The job-scraping part targets Danish job sites, but the flow itself is language- and country-agnostic and can be swapped for your own job sites; MIT-licensed, about 1400 stars in a day on Trending today. [GitHub](https://github.com/MadsLorentzen/ai-job-search)
> **[zh]** **ai-job-search**：一位地球物理学家被裁后用 Claude Code 搭的求职流水线，`/scrape` 搜职位、`/apply` 评估匹配度并起草定制的 LaTeX 简历和求职信（另有一个审稿 Agent 把关）、`/interview` 准备面试。作者说自己投了 69 份、拿到 20 个一面，最后在 2026 年 6 月入职 AI 工程师。职位抓取部分针对丹麦招聘站，但流程本身和语言、国家无关，可以换成自己的招聘站，MIT 许可，今天 Trending 单日约 1400 星。
4. **Google's official android/skills**: a set of Agent Skills (standard SKILL.md format) maintained by the Android team, written to developer.android.com best practices, deliberately covering only scenarios where evals show large models tend to go wrong (e.g. R8 obfuscation analysis, Wear OS Compose) and not repeating what models already know, like basic Compose. Install them into every agent detected on your machine at once with the Android CLI's `android skills add --all`, or install as a Claude Code plugin; Apache 2.0. [GitHub](https://github.com/android/skills) ｜ [官方文档](https://developer.android.com/tools/agents/android-skills)
> **[zh]** **Google 官方 android/skills**：Android 团队维护的一套 Agent Skills（标准 SKILL.md 格式），按 developer.android.com 的最佳实践写，刻意只覆盖评测显示大模型容易做错的场景（比如 R8 混淆分析、Wear OS Compose），不重复写基础 Compose 这类模型已经会的东西。可以用 Android CLI 的 `android skills add --all` 一次装进本机检测到的各个 Agent，也能当 Claude Code 插件装，Apache 2.0。

### 科技新闻

Meta chose to sign partnerships with Walmart, Gap, Best Buy and others so Muse can shop. For people building agent products, "which sites you can get into" is becoming a real capability ceiling. [The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/1013195/ai-agents-blocked-web)

> **[zh]** **Mercor：美国 90% 的工作时长落在 AI 基准几乎没测过的任务上**：Mercor 把现有 AI 基准的题目映射到美国劳工部 O*NET 的职业和任务上，发现覆盖很不均匀，偏向工资总额大的职业，比如律师的任务被大量覆盖，但同样容易被 AI 影响的法律秘书、书记员几乎没人测，长尾的中等收入知识工作基本是空白。这条是本时段开始前上的 HN，之前没写过。[原文](https://www.mercor.com/research/labor-index/benchmark-map/) ｜ [HN 讨论](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50121179)（541 分：高赞观点是人类大部分工作缺少训练和 Agent 需要的快速反馈闭环，所以生产率提升更像每年 2% 的老节奏；也有工程师自嘲 80% 的时间在调和各方意见）

The author's recommended use is to have an agent generate a set of pages or product assets, compare and partially edit them on the canvas, then export to the project's assets directory. Bring your own model, boards stored locally, MIT-licensed.
2. **LinuxDo：Codex Harbor**：一个 macOS 上的 Codex 桌面版启动器，账号和会话目录分开选，于是可以用 A 账号开的会话换 B 账号或自己的 Responses API 接着聊；支持多账号多开，启动前就能看到每个账号的 5 小时和周额度、重置时间，会话也能放在移动硬盘上。作者说还在公测，MIT 许可。[帖子](https://linux.do/t/topic/3037974) ｜ [GitHub](https://github.com/dongshuyan/codex-harbor-community)
> **[en]** **LinuxDo: Codex Harbor**: a launcher for the Codex desktop app on macOS where the account and the session directory are chosen separately, so a session started with account A can be continued with account B or your own Responses API; supports multiple accounts open at once, shows each account's 5-hour and weekly quota and reset time before launch, and sessions can live on an external drive. The author says it's in public beta, MIT-licensed.
3. **InfoQ：Akka 用 65 个开源项目实测「规格驱动」的 AI 代码移植**：首轮跑了 99.3 小时、94.1 亿 token，57 个项目的代码量或性能有改善。结论里比较实用的几点：带声明、证据和类型化行为的结构化规格能明显提高第一次实现的质量；主要瓶颈是上下文里缺少跨组件的设计决策；Opus 比 Sonnet 省约 40% token，但耗时翻倍，调高思考档位也没有带来持续收益。[InfoQ 中文](https://www.infoq.cn/article/uGNQwpOt5GGAKm2XlEZC) ｜ [英文原文](https://www.infoq.com/news/2026/10/ai-spec-driven-delivery/)
> **[en]** **InfoQ: Akka tested "spec-driven" AI code porting on 65 open-source projects**: the first round ran 99.3 hours and 9.41 billion tokens, with 57 projects improving in code size or performance. The more practical conclusions: structured specs with declarations, evidence and typed behavior clearly raise first-implementation quality; the main bottleneck is the lack of cross-component design decisions in context; Opus uses about 40% fewer tokens than Sonnet but takes twice as long, and raising the thinking level brought no consistent gain.
